.qc-cache/hireops-workspace-2026-10-03-r1/rules/harbor-webdev-rubric-qc/SKILL.md (incl. known false positive 'One criterion covering a whole flow', checks 26/28/33)
qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md (esp. 'Coverage has two directions', 'Independent credit takes precedence over flow grouping')
evidence: Built requirement->criterion map from instruction.md + hireops_rules.md against 43 functional, 5 polish, 5 visual and 2 gate criteria. WELL COVERED: one-stage moves (hro_move_one_stage), shared order (hro_reorder, hro_restart), Interview places (hro_interview_full, hro_interview_reorder_free, hro_undo_full, hro_bulk_places), refused put-back with reason and focus (hro_refused_put_back), stale 409 naming who (hro_stale_refused), bulk all-or-none and board order (hro_bulk_move, hro_bulk_all_or_none, hro_arrive_bottom), undo restore/conflict/once/reason restore (hro_undo_restores, hro_undo_conflict, hro_undo_once, hro_reopen), job validation (hro_job_open), email rules (hro_add_email_rules), reject/reopen (hro_reject_reason, hro_reject_hired, hro_reopen), HM/observer/candidate/anonymous permissions (hro_mgr_*, hro_observer_readonly, hro_candidate_no_staff, hro_anonymous), notes (hro_notes), activity incl. filter and refusal-free (hro_activity, hro_activity_refusals), 15s live board + preservation of open card/note/focus/scroll (hro_live_board, hro_pol_live_board), live thread draft/focus (hro_pol_live_thread), messages compose/blank/Enter/Shift+Enter/failed send (hro_msg_compose, hro_pol_failed_send), latest 30 / earlier 30 with remaining count / place kept (hro_thread_latest, hro_thread_earlier, hro_pol_earlier_place), unread per person + scrolled-up notice (hro_unread_counts, hro_unread_scrolled_up), seen with Observer exclusion (hro_seen), conversation access (hro_thread_access), drafts per conversation/reload/sign-out/other user (hro_drafts, hro_pol_session_resume), candidate wording/ownership/privacy/404/linking (hro_candidate_view, hro_candidate_private, hro_candidate_linked), restart persistence and no reseed (hro_restart), Board/Conversations/Activity/candidate views (visual rows, gates). UNGRADED REQUIREMENTS (gaps, not flow bundling): (1) hireops_rules.md section 2: 'Only a recruiter opens a job; the hiring manager is chosen from the hiring-manager accounts.' and section 1 role table (Hiring manager/Observer change nothing outside their scope). No criterion tries job opening as Observer, hiring manager or candidate: hro_observer_readonly covers only 'move, add-candidate or note', hro_candidate_no_staff only 'move, add-candidate and note', hro_job_open only validation of a Recruiter's job. Choosing a non-HM account as the job's hiring manager is also never tried. (2) instruction.md line 3: 'I want that to work without dragging as well as with it.' Dragging is asked for in the brief (rules section 3 softens it to 'Dragging may be offered as well', and the golden implements drag at solution/app/public/js/board.js:242,270,301) but every criterion grades only non-drag controls; hro_move_one_stage fails only if moving is 'only possible by dragging'. Either the brief asks for drag and it is ungraded, or brief and rules disagree; both need resolution. (3) rules section 6 Seen: 'A candidate's message is seen once a recruiter, or that job's hiring manager, has.' hro_seen grades only a staff message seen by the candidate. (4) rules section 3: hiring manager 'may reject from Interview or Offer ... Everything else is refused for them' and section 1 HM does not add candidates: hro_mgr_early_refused tries only Applied->Screen and Screen->Interview, no criterion tries HM add-candidate or HM rejecting from Applied/Screen. (5) rules section 3 Undo: 'Adding a note does not count as a change' is never exercised (no undo after a note). (6) rules section 2: candidate 'source' field is required input but no criterion checks it is kept/shown (hro_add_candidate checks name and email only). (7) rules section 1: 'Identity comes from the session ... and from nothing a request claims' has no spoofed-claim probe (replays only change session). (8) rules section 5: live arrival of seen marks and live change of unread counts while on the Board is not explicitly required to be without reload in hro_unread_counts/hro_seen. Items 1 and 2 are the material gaps; 3-8 are bounded. Static coverage analysis; no runtime needed for this row.
counterexample: A broken app that lets the Observer (aud.halvorsen) and any hiring manager open new jobs (and lets a job be opened with a Recruiter or Observer as its 'hiring manager'), offers no drag at all, never marks a candidate's message as seen by staff, and lets Ingrid add candidates or reject from Applied on her own job would still pass every functional, polish, visual and gate criterion as written, earning full reward despite violating explicit brief/rules requirements.
suggested_fix: Add to hro_observer_readonly / hro_candidate_no_staff / hro_mgr_early_refused a replay of the observed job-opening and add-candidate request (with a Recruiter success as control) plus a non-HM hiring-manager choice; either remove 'as well as with it' from instruction.md or grade drag in a criterion; extend hro_seen with a candidate-message-seen-by-recruiter leg (Observer still not counting).
